description: This PHP source file contains a unit test class `EmploymentContractAPITest` for testing the `EmploymentContractAPI` in the OrangeHRM project. It includes multiple test methods that verify the behavior of the API, such as retrieving, updating, deleting employment contracts, and handling attachments. The file sets up mocks for dependencies, tests different scenarios, and validates the API’s response normalization and validation rules.

classes.name: EmploymentContractAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class designed to validate the behavior of the `EmploymentContractAPI`, covering functionalities such as retrieval, update, deletion, attachment handling, and validation rules within the OrangeHRM HRM system.
